comments.body:
Hey, i also received an offer for a room there and accepted it. I visited the area and the apartment two weeks ago and I just loved it. The house is very modern and the rooms aren’t huge, but definitely big enough. They have a room with table tennis and a foosball table. And me personally, I love the grey walls and the industrial style. 
The area is quite green and not too crowded, but at the same time you still feel like you live in a big city. The forest and the Uetliberg are a 10 min train ride away from the area. So you can easily go for a spontaneous hike up the hill. Lidl and “cheap” groceries are also just a 5 minute walk away from the building and within 10 minutes you can cycle to the lake. So all in all I’d definitely recommend accepting the offer, i don’t think you’ll find anything better.
comments.author: kaengururu
